info.name: WEB4–WEB10 Subscription Usage Protocol
info.description: Run only with isolated staging subscribers. Configure base URL, user bearer and six separate service keys locally; never export secrets. Each folder performs included-request reserve/start/settle and replay checks. Actual provider prices/receipts and outage tests require the operations runbook. The retired authorize-request counter is not used.

item.name: Administrator: plan grants and app accounts
item.description: Administrator (Wizard) JWT required: set {{adminToken}}. Every change is audited with the administrator and reason. Keys are returned once, when an app account is created or its key rotated; store them as secrets.

item.name: Grant a plan to an avatar (no Stripe)

request.description: planId is free, bronze, silver, gold or enterprise. 409 if the avatar has an active Stripe subscription. Granting free reverts the avatar. expiresAtUtc is optional (at most 10 years).
The response contains apiKey exactly once. appId is 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.
Issues a new key and invalidates the old one at once.

item.name: Change an app account plan or disable it

request.description: Provide any of planId, status (active or disabled), pooledQuota, perUserPlanId. A disabled app's credentials stop working at once.

item.name: Create a POOLED app account (finite plan, shared by all users)

request.description: Needs the server setting OASIS_POOLED_APP_QUOTAS=true; otherwise a finite plan is refused (400). The plan is ONE pool shared by every user of the app; each user keeps personal limits at perUserPlanId (default silver, never enterprise) or their own plan, whichever is higher. When the pool is exhausted requests are denied with APP_-prefixed codes such as APP_MONTHLY_REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

item.name: Read an app pool's top users

request.description: The avatars using the most of the pool this UTC month, busiest first (limit 1 to 100).
This month's and today's pool usage against the plan limits, with the fraction used. poolActive is false when the app is not pooled or the feature flag is off.

item.name: Read quotas as a user through an app

request.description: App credentials are optional. When present and valid, WEB4 evaluates the request against the more generous of the app's plan and the user's own plan; invalid credentials are rejected (401). Usage is still recorded against the signed-in avatar.
